# get_pld_from_percolated_paths_path_windows { #mofography.compute.get_pld_from_percolated_paths_path_windows }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-deprecated">deprecated</span> Old RAG-path PLD helper; use the winding PLD instead. Use `find_pore_limiting_radius_winding` instead.

```python
compute.get_pld_from_percolated_paths_path_windows(paths, path_windows)
```

Return PLD as twice the smallest path-limiting window radius across the given paths.
